entries.title: Genesis 7:1
segments: It is not necessary for a man to be wicked because others around him are wicked.  Any one may, if he will, be righteous, even in the midst of abounding iniquity.  And every one whom God sees to be righteous through faith, will be saved when the wicked are destroyed.

entries.title: Genesis 7:5
segments: If men would be saved, they must not only believe God's declarations, but also make it their great object to obey all his commands.

entries.title: Genesis 7:10
segments: After seven days; on the seventh day it began to rain.

entries.title: Genesis 7:11
segments:
Second month; the year began late in september; and the second month, called Marchesvan answered to the last part of October and the first part of November. 
 
  Fountains of the great deep--windows of heaven; the waters rushed up from the sea, and poured down from the heavens.

entries.title: Genesis 7:15
segments: God has power not only over men, but also over beasts, and all the works of his hands.  He can influence, direct, and control them, as seemeth him good.

entries.title: Genesis 7:16
segments: Those who believe God's declarations and obey his commands, will receive his effectual protection and care.

entries.title: Genesis 7:20
segments:
Fifteen cubits; about twenty-two and a half feet. 
 
  Upward; above the highest land.

entries.title: Genesis 7:21
segments: Men who know the declarations of God but do not believe them, will be convinced of their truth by their fulfilment; and when he undertakes to punish, there is no possibility of escape.

entries.title: Genesis 7:24
segments: A hundred and fifty days; so long, it is supposed, the waters did not sensibly abate.
